description:
Get Instagram Reels

Fetches the Reels of a public Instagram account by username (handle), in Reels tab order (newest first, collab reels included), and returns each reel with play, like and comment counts, caption, hashtags, mentions, cover image, video URL, owner, tagged users, and timestamp. Each reel carries a hasdataLink to the comments endpoint. Supports token-based pagination via nextPageToken to walk older reels. Private accounts and handles that do not exist or are hidden from logged-out viewers return an error field instead of reels. Use to track reel performance (plays) of creators and competitors, or to build datasets of short-form video content; use the posts API for photos and carousels.

handle.description: The Instagram username of the account whose reels you want to scrape, without the `@` symbol.

limit.description: The maximum number of reels to retrieve per request, up to 12. Defaults to 12.

nextPageToken.description: Defines the next page token. It is used for retrieving the next page results. Use the `nextPageToken` value returned by the previous response.
